preflight_records.title: "You Again": Fingerprinting and Tracking Mechanisms of Malicious Sites
preflight_records.review_reason: Strong candidate for investigator OPSEC. Uses OpenWPM to compare six browser tracking/fingerprinting mechanisms on malicious pages and popular-site homepages. The paper cautions that mechanism presence alone cannot classify a page as malicious. Remaining checks: Existing quality/taxonomy/schema checks; current-corpus and exclusion deduplication; tool/platform currency check. Preserve sample attrition, broad detection proxies and homepage-comparison limits.
